content: Khri Zisu letei hringnah biakangpaw palanglai pawtah Khazing a rei tei Khri Zisu apostol a cangpaw kama Paul tah,
ka dopaw ka sawtei Timote khatah ca ka ca kua. Paw Khazing le kaa Buipaw Khri Zisu taiteipaw ningdonah, zawngenah le thlawlungnah cawh nama khatah ung ky seh.

Kaa mapaw sahlo aa za tua teipaw hrakhei, a rai ka hre pahpaw Khazing khatah a lawng neh ka, chiachaw thluidangnah a pasing teitah ching kha zai kha thlaw ka changnah maikaw letah ka ca thui paria thlang.
Na mehthli thlahpaw khah a thui thlang neh ka, ka lawngnah a tling nápawtah na hmui hmuh ka vang ngetei.
Na no Eunis tei a dihpaw zingnah a hnuipaw khah ka thui thlang. Na mano Lois zong tah ma hapaw zingnah cawh hnui ka, nama zong tah na hnui hrah tahpaw a se pawtah ka hni.
Macawtaco ka kih pahnianah thongtah na hmuhpaw Khazing lahsong khah melui hratah pahla vy leimei my lo tatah ching kaw ka ca dupaw a cang.
Khazing taco raechianah Thlawpaw ma pei be ca ka, hmingtuakhynah le donah le ma leh ma a hraipaking khynah Thlawpaw khah a ma peh hri.

Macawtaco kaa Buipaw kong rei cawh na ningzeh kheh seh la, Ama rawng tah thong a tlahpaw kama zong pa zawkhui hrah kheh. Canghrasala thawngchawbia rawng tei ka ingpaw hanah heh Khazing hmingtuakhynah thongtah a pa hrong hrah my lo.

Ama taco ma pachah ka, hringzia pathaipaw lang cawh ma y ka, kaaning tah hming kaa tuapaw rawng takhei cang lytah Ama tei a pachiapaw le a ningdonah rawng tah a cang. Ma ningdonah heh cai a patho hlai taitah Zisu Khri letah peh ciapaw ka cang thah peh.

Canghrasala atoheh cawh a ma Pachahtu Khri Zisu a za langnah thong khei a langsah myca, Ama taco thihnah cawh hlyde ka, hringnah leh thih khylynah khah thawngchawbia tah khainah letah a palang thah myca.
Taico ma thawngchawbia cawh tlang y pawtah le apostol le cawngpahtu cang rua pawtah Khazing tah a thingpaw ka cang hi.

Ma rawng tahei ma hrahei sisawnah ka ingpaw a cang hi. Canghmaisala ka ningzeh be, zecawtamaw tatah ahomaw ka zing tahpaw khah hnih neh ka, ma ning caw tei Ama ka chiasopaw khah achaw teitah a kai khy a tahpaw a sepaw tah ka hni.
Kama taitei na thuipaw cawngpahnah ahmangpaw khah a mingpai rua pawtah hmang la, Khri Zisu zingnah le donah khakhei a vo thlang my lo.
Hmingchaw aa cakai sahpaw khah achaw teitah vai la, kaa chung letei a hringpaw Thlawpaw Pathai bawná khei vai my lo.
Asia raang letei a ungpaw maikaw tah a pa huisai thlu thah he takhah na hni, aa hrong letah Figela le Hermozini a tae hrah he.
Kaa Buipaw taco, Onesifora ingchungkho cung letah a zawngenah cawh palang ky seh, zecawtamaw tatah thawthonah a pa pei leimei teipaw cang ka, bahrairui ka khipaw zong heh zawkhui be.
Ma lawng cawh cang lytah, Rom khua letah a ungning tah a pa hmuh hlai vytei a pa hui lai.
Ma ning taco Abuipaw tah a zawngenah cawh hmuhsah ky seh! Efesa khuapui letah ka ungning tah zehratamaw a pa bawkhang tahpaw khah a se pawtah na hni thlang kho.
